description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wanniyankulama, Nagenahira Nuwaragam Palatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110216 (23/120120)
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcel registrations, and title settlement procedures across various districts. This content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, title claims, and property ownership matters.
